_readme: Chats listed in `hiddenChatIds` are hidden from the chat list (all folders, archive, unread counters) and produce no notifications. For a person, use their user id (e.g. "123456789"); for a group or channel, use the chat id including the leading minus (e.g. "-1001234567890"). The id is visible in the URL hash when the chat is open. Rebuild the app after editing.
